1	"""Evaluators for kept MCE and OOD tasks."""
2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import json
6	import re
7	from collections.abc import Callable
8	
9	from .constants import TRANSFER_TASKS
10	
11	
12	def extract_final_answer(response_text: str) -> str:
13	    if not response_text:
14	        return ""
15	
16	    text = response_text.strip()
17	    if text.startswith("```"):
18	        lines = text.splitlines()
19	        payload = []
20	        in_json = False
21	        for line in lines:
22	            stripped = line.strip()
23	            if stripped.startswith("```json"):
24	                in_json = True
25	                continue
26	            if stripped.startswith("```") and in_json:
27	                break
28	            if in_json:
29	                payload.append(line)
30	        if payload:
31	            text = "\n".join(payload)
32	        elif "```" in text:
33	            parts = text.split("```")
34	            if len(parts) >= 3:
35	                text = parts[1]
36	                if text.startswith("json"):
37	                    text = text[4:].strip()
38	
39	    try:
40	        data = json.loads(text)
41	        if isinstance(data, dict) and "final_answer" in data:
42	            return str(data["final_answer"])
43	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
44	        pass
45	
46	    match = re.search(r"\{[^{}]*(?:\{[^{}]*\}[^{}]*)*\}", text)
47	    if match:
48	        try:
49	            data = json.loads(match.group())
50	            if isinstance(data, dict) and "final_answer" in data:
51	                return str(data["final_answer"])
52	        except json.JSONDecodeError:
53	            pass
54	
55	    return response_text
56	
57	
58	def eval_finer(prediction: str, target: str) -> bool:
59	    return extract_final_answer(prediction).lower().strip() == target.lower().strip()
60	
61	
62	def eval_uspto(prediction: str, target: str) -> dict:
63	    def parse_reactants(smiles: str) -> set[str]:
64	        return {
65	            part.strip().lower() for part in smiles.strip().split(".") if part.strip()
66	        }
67	
68	    pred_set = parse_reactants(extract_final_answer(prediction))
69	    target_set = parse_reactants(target)
70	    if not pred_set and not target_set:
71	        jaccard = 1.0
72	    elif not pred_set or not target_set:
73	        jaccard = 0.0
74	    else:
75	        jaccard = len(pred_set & target_set) / len(pred_set | target_set)
76	    return {"correct": pred_set == target_set, "jaccard_similarity": jaccard}
77	
78	
79	def eval_symptom2disease(prediction: str, target: str) -> bool:
80	    text = extract_final_answer(prediction)
81	    match = re.search(r"\[DIAGNOSIS\](.*?)\[/DIAGNOSIS\]", text, re.I | re.S)
82	    if match:
83	        text = match.group(1).strip()
84	    else:
85	        match = re.search(
86	            r"(?:diagnosis|final diagnosis|conclusion)[:：]\s*([^\n]+)", text, re.I
87	        )
88	        if match:
89	            text = match.group(1).strip()
90	
91	    def normalize(value: str) -> str:
92	        value = value.lower().strip()
93	        value = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", value)
94	        return re.sub(r"[.!?]+$", "", value)
95	
96	    return normalize(text) == normalize(target)
97	
98	
99	def eval_lawbench(prediction: str, target: str) -> dict:
100	    def parse_charges(text: str) -> set[str]:
101	        text = extract_final_answer(text).strip()
102	        match = re.search(r"\[罪名\](.*?)(?:<eoa>|$)", text)
103	        if match:
104	            text = match.group(1).strip()
105	        elif "罪名:" in text:
106	            text = text.split("罪名:")[-1]
107	        text = re.sub(r"<eoa>.*", "", text).strip()
108	        for sep in [";", "；", ",", "，", "、"]:
109	            if sep in text:
110	                return {part.strip() for part in text.split(sep) if part.strip()}
111	        return {text} if text else set()
112	
113	    pred_charges = parse_charges(prediction)
114	    true_charges = parse_charges(target)
115	    tp = len(pred_charges & true_charges)
116	    fp = len(pred_charges - true_charges)
117	    fn = len(true_charges - pred_charges)
118	    precision = tp / (tp + fp) if tp + fp else 0.0
119	    recall = tp / (tp + fn) if tp + fn else 0.0
120	    f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) if precision + recall else 0.0
121	    return {
122	        "correct": pred_charges == true_charges,
123	        "f1": f1,
124	        "precision": precision,
125	        "recall": recall,
126	        "tp": tp,
127	        "fp": fp,
128	        "fn": fn,
129	    }
130	
131	
132	def eval_aegis(prediction: str, target: str) -> bool:
133	    pred = extract_final_answer(prediction).lower()
134	    if "unsafe" in pred:
135	        pred = "unsafe"
136	    elif "safe" in pred:
137	        pred = "safe"
138	    else:
139	        pred = pred.strip()
140	    return pred == target.lower().strip()
141	
142	
143	def eval_classification(prediction: str, target: str) -> bool:
144	    def normalize(text: str) -> str:
145	        text = extract_final_answer(text).lower().strip()
146	        text = text.replace("_", " ")
147	        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
148	        return re.sub(r"[.!?]+$", "", text)
149	
150	    return normalize(prediction) == normalize(target)
151	
152	
153	def get_evaluator(task: str) -> Callable:
154	    if task == "FiNER":
155	        return lambda pred, target, **kwargs: eval_finer(pred, target)
156	    if task == "USPTO":
157	
158	        def _eval_uspto(pred: str, target: str, **kwargs) -> dict:
159	            raw = eval_uspto(pred, target)
160	            return {
161	                "was_correct": raw["correct"],
162	                "metrics": {"jaccard_similarity": raw["jaccard_similarity"]},
163	            }
164	
165	        return _eval_uspto
166	    if task == "Symptom2Disease":
167	        return lambda pred, target, **kwargs: eval_symptom2disease(pred, target)
168	    if task == "LawBench":
169	
170	        def _eval_lawbench(pred: str, target: str, **kwargs) -> dict:
171	            raw = eval_lawbench(pred, target)
172	            return {
173	                "was_correct": raw["correct"],
174	                "metrics": {
175	                    "f1": raw["f1"],
176	                    "precision": raw["precision"],
177	                    "recall": raw["recall"],
178	                    "tp": raw["tp"],
179	                    "fp": raw["fp"],
180	                    "fn": raw["fn"],
181	                },
182	            }
183	
184	        return _eval_lawbench
185	    if task == "AEGIS":
186	        return lambda pred, target, **kwargs: eval_aegis(pred, target)
187	    if task in TRANSFER_TASKS:
188	        return lambda pred, target, **kwargs: eval_classification(pred, target)
189	    raise ValueError(f"Unknown task: {task}")
190
